about.title: About Me
about.bio_p1: I'm a <1>Computer Science engineering student</1> specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, with a strong passion for building responsive web applications and intelligent systems. I enjoy crafting solutions that bridge <1>creativity, code, and data-driven thinking.</1>
about.bio_p2: Currently pursuing a <1>B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (AI & ML)</1> at Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology, I've gained hands-on experience as a Web Development Intern — building interactive UIs with React.js, designing Figma prototypes, and developing CNN-based ML models deployed with Streamlit.
about.bio_p3: My goal is to grow into a <1>skilled AI/ML engineer and full stack developer</1>. I thrive at the intersection of frontend development and machine learning — turning complex ideas into clean, functional, and impactful applications.

p1.desc: A Reddit-style discussion platform with posting and commenting features. Backend powered by PHP and MySQL, running locally via XAMPP.

p2.desc: A responsive image gallery with category filtering and lightbox preview, built with React Hooks and deployed on Vercel.

p3.desc: A CNN-based image classification model for parasite detection, deployed as an interactive web app using Streamlit.

p4.desc: A clean, interactive GST calculator for computing tax breakdowns across different GST slabs.
